sloka: तोषिताः कर्मणा अनेन स्नेहम् दर्शय राघवे ।प्रजापतेः कृशाश्वस्य पुत्रान् सत्य पराक्रमान् ॥१-२६-२९॥
transliteration: toṣitāḥ karmaṇā anena sneham darśaya rāghave ।prajāpateḥ kṛśāśvasya putrān satya parākramān ॥1-26-29॥

translations.english: "O Brahmarshi, you may offer to Rama, the sons of Prajapati Brishasva who are the weapons bestowed with the power that comes from truth and ascetic energy".
